content.rendered:
HEAR IT

“Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.”
(Ezekiel 37: 4)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In our Focal Scripture, God told Ezekiel to prophesy to the dry bones, and they came back to life. Ezekiel may have given up on the dry bones, but what he heard from God spurred him into action. What God said energized him and activated his capacity as a prophet. God’s word awakened him.

Friend, what you hear from God will push you into action. One word from God will embolden you to take a leap where men fear to tread. Hearing a testimony of what God has done for someone else may be all you need to believe God for your own miracle.

One word from scriptures may be the missing link between where you are and where God is about to take you to. Your next exploit may be connected to that word you have not yet heard.

Ezekiel heard from God, and as he acted on what he heard, a mighty miracle happened. When you hear from God and forget what you heard, you are disconnecting yourself from mighty miracles that should arise from what you heard.

Ezekiel’s faith received a boost when he heard a word from God. One word from God will boost your faith. If you find it difficult to believe God, just hear one word from Him. The things you desire may not be feasible, your next level may seem impossible, but just one word from God will shore up your faith to believe again.

Open your ears and hear one more word from God; search the scriptures and find words from God that speak of your situation; shore up your faith by listening more to God’s word. You may have heard several words of men, but it is time to hear one word from God.

Romans 10 vs. 17 sums it up: “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”

Pray With Me: Lord, I choose to hear Your word; increase my faith, in Jesus’ name!
